source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 4% articaine block anesthesia, incision, crown division, removal of resistance, loosening, pulling out tooth fragments, scraping, suturing, and compression to stop bleeding.
